regulationVersions.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (Base Notification GSR 202(E))
regulationVersions.amendmentSummary: Principal notification under Legal Metrology Act, 2009 for pre-packaged commodities.
regulationVersions.officialDisclaimer: Prototype rule dataset — requires official verification by an authorized Legal Metrology Officer before legal enforcement.

regulationVersions.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2017 (GSR 629(E))
regulationVersions.amendmentSummary: Enhanced font height table, e-commerce mandatory declarations, dual MRP prohibition.
regulationVersions.officialDisclaimer: Prototype rule dataset — requires official verification by an authorized Legal Metrology Officer before legal enforcement.

regulationVersions.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021 & 2022 (GSR 779(E))
regulationVersions.amendmentSummary: Mandatory Unit Sale Price (USP) per g/ml/kg/L, standard unit formats, country of origin, customer care specifics.
regulationVersions.officialDisclaimer: Prototype rule dataset — requires official verification by an authorized Legal Metrology Officer before legal enforcement.

requirements.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name & Address
requirements.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where manufacturer is not packer, both manufacturer & packer; for imported goods, complete name & address of importer.

requirements.title: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
requirements.description: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be clearly stated.

requirements.title: Net Quantity in Standard SI Units
requirements.description: Net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight (g, kg), volume (ml, L), length (m, cm), or number (N / U). Non-standard units (e.g., lbs, oz, bottles) are prohibited.
requirements.sourceReference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(c) read with Rule 11

requirements.title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
requirements.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported in MM/YYYY or Month Year format.

requirements.title: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
requirements.description: Unit sale price in rupees rounded to two decimal places: per g/ml when net quantity is under 1kg/1L, or per kg/L when above 1kg/1L.
requirements.exceptionNotes: Exempt for packages where net content equals exactly 1 unit or under special exemptions.
requirements.sourceReference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021, GSR 779(E)

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) with All Taxes
requirements.description: MRP in Indian Rupees, clearly stating "inclusive of all taxes" or "(incl. of all taxes)". Dual pricing or overwriting is prohibited.

requirements.title: Consumer Care Contact Details
requirements.description: Name, address, telephone number, and email address of the designated consumer care representative or department.

requirements.title: Country of Origin for Imported Goods
requirements.description: Name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in the case of imported products.
requirements.exceptionNotes: Mandatory specifically for imported packages under Rule 6(1)(g).
